scope: Four existing training-only hypotheses on one new native-preserving boundary wrapper; no new baselines or architecture hypotheses.

implementation_status.new_native_preserving_boundary_wrapper: source-preset native adapters/providers not yet qualified
implementation_status.historical_TABMModel: implemented generic scaffold; not a paper-native-preserving constructor

native_preservation.parameter_identity: Every existing native W/b/attention/normalization/embedding parameter remains the same parameter object; no replacement, deletion, reinitialization, cloning into a generic scaffold, or detaching.
native_preservation.native_equations: All native nonlinearities, residuals, attention equations, normalization modules and call order remain in the original forward.
native_preservation.normalization: Retain BatchNorm/LayerNorm/GraphNorm types, affine parameters, eps/momentum, running buffers, counters and train/eval behavior; no normalization substitution or freezing.
native_preservation.stateful_routes: Each recipe declares source-native buffer ownership and four-route execution order ahead of time. Do not combine route batches, silently change BN update cadence, duplicate/drop buffers or claim the bank has the same state trajectory as M1.
native_preservation.preprocessing: Retain native feature transforms, atom/bond categorical encoders, graph construction/self loops/edge ordering, masks, target missingness, sampler and augmentation laws.
native_preservation.native_loss: Retain source task loss interface, reductions, masks, class weights, label smoothing and explicit regularizers; R_native uses its original parameter set and coefficient exactly once.
native_preservation.optimizer: Retain every existing native parameter group, assignment, optimizer class, per-group LR/weight decay/betas/eps, scheduler and source transition schedule; no transplant of prototype Adam/AdamW defaults.
native_preservation.private_optimizer_rule: Before execution, assign R/S to their native boundary weight group and delta_b to the native boundary bias group, or to its weight group if no native bias exists; inherit all group options without a search. Existing native parameter memberships remain intact.
native_preservation.native_M1_prediction: Use its original source forward/output activation/prediction path unaltered.

boundary_specification.placement: Exactly the two original input/output boundary sites identified ahead of time for each adopted native recipe. No module traversal, internal placements, architecture-specific capacity additions or placement search.
boundary_specification.continuous_affine_supported_form: y_m = s_m * native_affine(r_m * x) + delta_b_m; native_affine owns its unchanged native W and native b. This includes the native bias inside its original affine call; delta_b is an additive private residual, never a replacement for native b.
boundary_specification.private_parameters: Only route-private input/output diagonal factors R/S and additive bias residual delta_b at those two sites, in the original boundary dimensions; no additional dense weights or heads.
boundary_specification.neutral_state: R=1, S=1, delta_b=0 at both sites must recover the native function with the same input/state/RNG for a corresponding forward. This is a required source/algebraic property, not a numerical result of this document.
boundary_specification.initialization: Fixed isolated Torch CPU-generator first-input R Rademacher for every method; all other R/S one and delta_b zero. Native initialization unchanged. Actual sign start is not neutral; no initializer sweep.
boundary_specification.historical_difference: Historical TABMModel creates new bias-free W with Xavier initialization and substitutes a generic scaffold, so it cannot be copied wholesale. Its Rademacher first-R initializer and B replacement are source history, not proof that a new native wrapper preserves W/b or starts native-equal.
boundary_specification.input_encoding_limitation: Never multiply categorical atom/bond/type IDs by private factors or replace native categorical embeddings with a float linear stem. A continuous post-encoding factor adapter requires its exact site, dimensions and source law to be declared; if the original input R/S law cannot be preserved, flag unsupported/needs port rather than inventing an adapter.
boundary_specification.output_limitation: An unambiguous native raw-logit tensor and boundary output map are required. Multihead/conditional heads, fused activations, embeddings or opaque native logits need an explicit source-specific adapter; no generic best-effort hook.
boundary_specification.embedding_supported_form: native_embedding(IDs) * R_m[IDs][...,None] * S_m + delta_b_m; native IDs and native embedding calls/options remain unchanged.

aggregation.GNNM_and_I4_domain: same native raw logits, captured before the native output activation
aggregation.GNNM_and_I4_rule: arithmetic mean of four raw-logit tensors, with aligned native class/output axes, then unchanged native output activation/interpretation where required
aggregation.raw_logit_capture: Capture from the original forward by a passive, predeclared source hook/interface. Keep the native output activation in place; never remove it or infer logits by inverse-transforming probabilities.
aggregation.native_M1: Return its source prediction unaltered; raw-logit capture is observation only.
aggregation.training_L: Use the loss interface associated with the above fixed aggregate and native activation. Preserve native loss/regularizer semantics; no silent probability-pool substitution.
aggregation.historical_outputs: Existing original scores/predictions/artifacts remain unchanged. The new adaptation is separately named; no retroactive reaggregation or relabeling.

recipe_template.fixed_aggregation_domain_and_rule: mean raw logits for both GNNM and I4; native interpretation after aggregation
